faq.p_3: Can't find your question? Call us. A person answers, usually on the second ring.
faq.summary_6_html: Do I need a referral?
faq.p_7: No. You can book a family doctor, a check-up, tests or most specialists directly. If a specialist does need a referral, your family doctor will arrange it.
faq.p_9: Yes, from newborns. Our family doctors see the whole family, and a pediatrician is here on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
faq.summary_10_html: Do you work with insurance?
faq.p_11: We are a self-pay clinic. After each visit you get an itemized receipt, which many insurers accept for reimbursement. Check with your insurer before you book.
faq.summary_12_html: How quickly do test results come back?
faq.p_13: Most blood tests are back within 48 hours. A few specialized tests take up to a week. Your doctor calls or messages you to explain them.
faq.summary_14_html: What is IV therapy at Averin?
faq.p_15: Fluids or vitamins given through a drip in our treatment lounge. A doctor assesses you first and only recommends it when there is a medical reason, such as dehydration or a confirmed deficiency.
faq.summary_16_html: What can be handled in a video visit?
faq.p_17: Follow-ups, test results, repeat prescriptions, minor skin problems and general questions. If your doctor needs to examine you, they will book you in person.
faq.summary_18_html: How do I cancel or move a visit?
faq.p_19: Call or email us. It's free up to 24 hours before the visit. After that we charge half the visit fee.
